name: Shuiqian Gushi:Shengxin
source:
A writer obsessed with words, a voice in their mind like that of a god, and a strange story unfolding in the depths of winter. Between a cup of coffee and a cigarette, you are the deity that intervenes in the course of the story, guiding the writer to complete the narrative and its ending...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3488610/]Steam[/url]]
